title: Venice Beach Tour in French: Culture, Canals and Street Art
includes: Photos of you, for memories that last
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Venice Beach on a 3-hour immersive tour, where street art, skateboarders and the vibrant energy of the beach and neighborhood await you. Explore the famous boardwalk, admire Venice-inspired canals and stroll through picturesque streets while listening to captivating anecdotes about local history. A Francophone Guide will immerse you in California culture, making the tour accessible and rewarding for all.

 - 3-hour small group tour (max 10 people)
 - Discover the boardwalk, canals and iconic Abbot Kinney Street
 - Francophone Guide to Authentic Immersion in Local Culture
 - Accessible to people with reduced mobility, on request
